limits: The original exact recipient decoder and fixed query cohorts remain unchanged.
Support masks diagnose certificate restrictions, not causal controller effects.
Ignoring a certificate restriction does not reconstruct missing counts.
Uniform spatial and discrete-sample temporal allocation is a conditional estimator.
Unpublished support and ambiguous semantic classes remain unknown.
Missing publication is not evidence of zero; private source never fills public support.
One recording and deterministic re-evaluation do not establish statistical superiority.
No additional release, policy change, measured privacy gain, or real-time claim.

recipient_contract.exact_decoder: conservative whole-public-tile containment; not maximal transcript inference
recipient_contract.lateness: seal exceeds query deadline; every diagnosed release is observed by source EOF
recipient_contract.signature: bitwise union over positive intersecting volumes, plus bit 16 for unpublished support; censored and unsampled queries separate
recipient_contract.support_unit: finest Morton leaf x scheduled sample; repeated for each category query
recipient_contract.uniform_estimate_rule: public category count x intersected leaves / public leaves x intersected scheduled samples / public scheduled samples; full visible semantically resolved support required; no missing-zero or semantic imputation
recipient_contract.unpublished: no public record through EOF, not a claim of emptiness or a producer suppression cause

table_notes: Rows use the explicitly named columns in order to keep the package small.
Score/paired groups include all ten nested taxonomy categories plus aggregate and reference-positive/zero strata.
Diagnostic tables include aggregate and Road User support; complete category diagnostics remain in ignored study files.
Error is observation contributions; occupancy error is mean sampled Road Users.
Boundary/censored results are separate from the common interior cohort.
No individual observations, source identities, movements, raw releases or per-query rows are included.
